types.name: PdfAConverter
types.fixture_strategy: programmatic_pdf_single — same as Optimizer. Create 1-page PDF via Aspose.Pdf.Document(). No special content needed.
types.output_validation: output file exists and size > 0; optionally check magic bytes are PDF header
forbidden_core_substitutions: Aspose.Pdf.PdfFormatConversionOptions — core API, not LowCode
required_constraints: REQUIRED: new PdfAConverter().Process(options) — use LowCode PdfAConverter plugin
REQUIRED: using Aspose.Pdf.LowCode;
types.notes: PDF/A conformance output differs only in metadata. File output validation (size > 0) is sufficient. Low complexity.
types.deferred_reason_original: PDF/A conformance validation requires specialized tooling
types.deferred_reason_reassessment: NOT a blocking concern for example generation. File output validation is sufficient for an example demonstrating the API call.

REQUIRED: using Aspose.Pdf.LowCode;
types.notes: Simplest form: PDF input → HTML output. method_count=2 includes both directions. Use PDF→HTML (fewer fixture deps).
types.deferred_reason_original: HTML-to-PDF may require license check; output format differs
types.deferred_reason_reassessment: PDF-to-HTML direction has same input as other PDF types. Output validation: file exists + html content check.

batch_gating_conditions.batch_2_gate: GATED — batch 1 must have 2+ consecutive PASS runs AND live PRs merged before batch 2 starts. TableGenerator needs builder-pattern few-shot example added to pdf.yml template_hints.
batch_gating_conditions.batch_3_gate: GATED — embedded-image PDF fixture strategy must be designed before ImageExtractor. Cert fixture strategy must be designed before Signature. Security (encryption-only) could advance to batch 2 if decision made.
batch_gating_conditions.batch_4_gate: GATED — AcroForm PDF fixture strategy required. Blocking taskcard: TASK-NEW-15-followup-fixture-gap-relaunch-system.
batch_gating_conditions.batch_5_gate: BLOCKED — external file/network dependencies. Needs explicit human decision to proceed.
